$doc: UI Capability Parity (CLAUDE.md): every capability whose contract declares the `app` layer is bound here to the page a person operates it on, and to the runtime artifact that proves that page works. Law: a capability that declares "app" MUST have a binding whose `page` exists and renders without an error page. Enforced by `pnpm check:ui-parity --strict` (tools/scripts/check_ui_parity.mjs), which reads this file because tools/scripts/lib/app-dir.mjs now points APP_DIR at apps/app (WL-50). A capability with no rev1 surface does not get a binding here — its `app` layer is retired instead, and ADR-081 names it with the lane that restores it.

$binding_shape.route: URL path pattern the human navigates to, e.g. /[org]/[ws]/tools
$binding_shape.page: repo-relative page.tsx (or route.ts) that renders/handles the surface
$binding_shape.entry: the concrete UI affordance that invokes the capability — human-readable
$binding_shape.testid: optional data-testid on the entry-point element
$binding_shape.proof: path to the runtime proof: an apps/app component or action test, or verifications/<session>/<name>.png
$binding_shape.verifiedAt: YYYY-MM-DD the proof was captured against a working page
$binding_shape.also: optional array of the second and later pages the same capability is operated on, each entry shaped like the binding itself (route, page, entry, optional testid, proof) and held to the same bar by check_ui_parity.mjs
